description: Source code for managing interface stack data structures and functions related to network interface configurations, including retrieval and creation of interface instances, and handling of interface hierarchy within a network device configuration context.

classes.name: interfacestack_data
classes.description: Data structure representing interface hierarchy with higher/lower layers and aliases.

methods.name: browseInterfaceStackInst
methods.description: Main function to browse and create interface stack instances based on device configuration.

methods.name: get_InterfaceStack_Alias
methods.description: Getter for the interface stack alias, formats as 'cpe-<instance>'.

methods.name: set_InterfaceStack_Alias
methods.description: Setter for the interface stack alias (no operation).

methods.name: get_InterfaceStack_HigherLayer
methods.description: Getter for the higher layer interface path.

methods.name: get_InterfaceStack_LowerLayer
methods.description: Getter for the lower layer interface path.

methods.name: get_InterfaceStack_HigherAlias
methods.description: Getter for the higher layer alias.

methods.name: get_InterfaceStack_LowerAlias
methods.description: Getter for the lower layer alias.
